race.title: Visit racingtv.com Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
race.verdict: THEATRE TOM would've gone very close at Worcester if not for a late fall on his penultimate outing and perhaps wasn't ideally suited by the step up in trip there last time, so makes most appeal dropping back to this trip. Mandarb made great strides in 2 handicap starts last season and may not have finished improving, whilst Gentleman Bill is also respected after a solid second on his return. THEATRE TOM (IRE) MANDARB (FR) GENTLEMAN BILL (IRE)
